mechanism: Both drugs can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, with propylthiouracil carrying an inherent risk and infliximab increasing susceptibility to infections and hematologic toxicity through TNF-alpha inhibition.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly; consider alternative antithyroid agents (methimazole); discontinue propylthiouracil if absolute neutrophil count falls below 1500 cells/μL or signs of infection develop.
